'''Tomo-Reth''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Tomo-Reth system/Legends|Tomo-Reth system]], a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was the site of the [[Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth]], a famous, more than fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]&ndash;high [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that sat on a brick [[Throne/Legends|throne]] and breathed [[Fire/Legends|fire]] at visitors, causing them to become amazed.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[14,743 BBY]], the Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth was annihilated during the event known as the [[Herglic Crush]]. The [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] included the droid in the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]], a list of antique objects created by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings that he compiled for his [[10,000 BBY]] work [[Arturum Galactinum]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth: God, I loved naming these things.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
Tomo-Reth was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-14.<ref name="TEA" /> Wallace noted in his personal blog that he particularly enjoyed creating names for those of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy that were original to the book, which included the Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth.<ref name="Blog" />
